name: zalo-lite-root
description: Root package for running microservices individually

scripts.build:all: npm run build:gateway && npm run build:user && npm run build:chat && npm run build:chatbot && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:post
scripts.install:all: cd backend/api-gateway && npm install && cd ../../backend/services/user-service && npm install && cd ../../../backend/services/chat-service && npm install && cd ../../../backend/services/chatbot-service && npm install && cd ../../../frontend/web && npm install && cd ../../../backend/services/post-service && npm install
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:user" "npm run start:chat" "npm run start:chatbot" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:post"
